0.body:
NoeDB is a distributed SQL engine written in Rust: lexer → parser → planner → Raft → LSM. v2.0.0 ships MVCC transactions, TLS/mTLS gRPC, window functions, CTEs, set operations, column statistics, Prometheus metrics, and multi-language gRPC clients. cargo run -p noedb-cli
cargo run -p noedb-cli -- --server --metrics-listen 127.0.0.1:9090

1.body: SQL → noedb-lexer → noedb-parser → noedb-ast → noedb-planner → noedb-engine → noedb-raft (optional) → noedb-storage (LSM) Crate Role noedb-lexer Tokenization, spans noedb-parser AST construction noedb-planner Logical/physical plans, execution noedb-storage LSM, WAL, MVCC, SSTables noedb-raft Consensus, replication noedb-engine End-to-end SQL noedb-grpc gRPC SQL API noedb-pool Connection pool + read/write routing noedb-metrics Prometheus exposition Clients live under clients/ (Python, Go, Node.js).

3.body: MemTable — in-memory sorted map, flushed when full. WAL — append-only durability before memtable apply. SSTables — immutable sorted files with bloom / XOR filters and optional LZ4 blocks.
3.title: LSM layout

4.body: Each key stores multiple Version values keyed by commit timestamp. Reads use a ReadView snapshot; writes buffer in TxnManager until COMMIT. Garbage collection (gc_versions, gc_mvcc_active) drops versions below the oldest active snapshot.
4.title: MVCC

5.body: L0 files merge into L1+ via k-way merge, preserving ordering and filters.
5.title: Compaction

6.body: NoeDB implements Raft (Ongaro & Ousterhout) in noedb-raft: Election — RequestVote with randomized timeouts. Replication — batched AppendEntries, pipelining, group commit. Linearizable reads — ReadIndex barrier on the leader. Membership — joint-configuration changes (add_voter). DistributedEngine runs an in-process 3-node cluster for tests; production paths use TLS-framed RPC (TlsTcpTransport) and gRPC (noedb-grpc).
6.title: Raft & distribution

7.body: ShardRouter hashes row keys to shards; each shard maps to a Raft group (roadmap: multi-region deployment).
7.title: Sharding

9.body: Parse SQL → AST (noedb-parser). Build logical plan (LogicalPlan: scan, filter, join, aggregate, window, CTE, set ops). Optimize — predicate pushdown, index vs seq scan costing (cost.rs, stats.rs). Lower to physical plan and execute (executor.rs, parallel.rs, simd_pred.rs).
